meaning:
τροπή, -ῆς, ἡ
(τρέπω), [in LXX: Deu.33:14, Job.38:33, Wis.7:18, al. ;]
a turning: esp. of the revolution of heavenly bodies, figuratively, Jas.1:17 (see: ἀποσκίασμα).†

elsewhere.note: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.
